Class ChaosAgentExtension

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.spring.boot3.test.ChaosAgentExtension
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterAllCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeAllCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.Extension, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.InvocationInterceptor, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterResolver
public final class ChaosAgentExtension extends Object implements org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeAllCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterAllCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.InvocationInterceptor, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterResolver
JUnit 5 extension that installs the chaos agent once per test JVM and opens a class-scoped ChaosSession for the annotated test class.

Used by ChaosTest. May also be combined directly via @ExtendWith(ChaosAgentExtension.class) on any class annotated with SpringBootTest.

Lifecycle

  • beforeAll: self-attach the agent (idempotent) and open one session for the whole class. A @Nested class runs inside its outer class and shares its session. The opening thread is unbound again at once (bindSession(null)), so the application context, which Spring starts after beforeAll, starts outside the session: a long-lived thread it starts (an event loop, a consumer, a worker loop) serves the whole application, not the class that happened to start the context.
  • Every test method (also a template, a factory and its dynamic tests) and every @BeforeAll, @BeforeEach, @AfterEach and @AfterAll method runs bound to the class's session, on whichever thread runs it. The test class's constructor, where Spring may start the context, does not.
  • beforeTestExecution / afterTestExecution: activate the method's WithChaos scenarios right before the test method runs and stop them right after it, so the test's @BeforeEach and @AfterEach methods run without them.
  • afterAll: close the session, stopping every session-scoped scenario activated during the class; a @Nested class only stops its own class-level scenarios.

Parameter injection

The extension injects ChaosSession and ChaosControlPlane parameters on test methods and lifecycle methods. A parameter Spring autowires is left to Spring: one of an autowired test constructor (@Autowired, @TestConstructor(autowireMode = ALL) or spring.test.constructor.autowire.mode=all) and one annotated @Autowired, @Value or @Qualifier. Spring injects the context's ChaosControlPlane bean there; a ChaosSession is not a bean, so Spring reports it as missing.
